你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

## 待审文本（按字段）

 "reply": "Hi Mark,\n\nThank you for your inquiry about our 1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle (model KET-17S). Before we get to pricing, here are the answers to your key requirements.\n\n1. UL listing\nThis model is not UL listed, and it does not have ETL either. Its current certifications are a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15) and CE (LVD/EMC). The US version runs on 120V 60Hz, 1500W.\nIf UL or ETL is a must for your Amazon listing, please let me know. I will check with our team whether certification is possible for this model, and what the timing and cost would be. Certification would add time to the first order.\n\n2. BPA free\nThe inner body is 304 stainless steel. The lid and handle are PP plastic. We have not done a BPA test on this model, so we cannot provide a BPA-free claim or report at this time. If you need a test report, please tell me and I will check the options internally.\n\n3. Your logo on the box\nNo problem. For 1,200 pcs the logo printing on the color box is free of charge. We just need your logo as a vector file (AI/PDF/EPS).\n\nQuotation:\n- Product: KET-17S, 1.7L, 304 stainless steel inner, auto shut-off, boil-dry protection, 360° swivel base, concealed heating element\n- Quantity: 1,200 pcs (our MOQ is 500 pcs)\n- Price: USD 9.80/pc, FOB Ningbo by sea (Ningbo-Zhoushan port)\n- Total: USD 11,760.00\n- Packing: color box, 6 units per carton\n\nAbout air shipment: FOB applies only to sea freight, so our quote is FOB Ningbo by sea. If you prefer to ship by air, we would need to quote under a different term, such as FCA. I can check this separately for you.\n\nLead time: Our production lead time is 35 days after we receive the deposit and confirm your artwork. Shipping time is not included in this. Unfortunately, we cannot have goods delivered within 20 days.\n\nPayment terms: We accept either of the following:\n- 30% T/T deposit, with the 70% balance against the B/L copy\n- L/C at sight\nWe are not able to accept 100% payment 60 days after delivery.\n\nSuggested next steps:\n- Samples: We can send samples before the order. Samples are charged at the unit price, and you cover the international freight. The sample cost will be deducted from your bulk order.\n- Video factory audit: We can arrange a live video tour of our factory through an Alibaba video call.\n\nPlease let me know whether the CB/CE certification, the 35-day lead time and our payment terms can work for you. If UL/ETL is required, I will come back to you with what is possible.\n\nBest regards,\nSales Team\nYongjiang Small Appliances"
}

content: {"findings": [{"rule_id": "INC-02", "quote": "Price: USD 9.80/pc, FOB Ningbo by sea (Ningbo-Zhoushan port)", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "1,200 台水壶（约 200 箱）海运基本会走集装箱（拼柜或整柜）。按 Incoterms 的说明，集装箱货物通常在码头堆场交给承运人，FCA 比 FOB 更合适。回复只在空运场景提到 FCA，海运集装箱报价没有提示 FCA 这个选项。", "suggestion_zh": "保留 FOB Ningbo 报价，在后面补一句可选说明，例如：\"As the goods will ship in a container, we can also quote FCA Ningbo (delivery to the carrier at the container terminal/CFS) if you prefer.\" 是否采用由业务员确认。"}]}
